messages.subject: Dev version dartR - installation
parts:
Hi,
I just updated my RStudio and R versions after experiencing a lot of sudden crashes while trying to run the function gl.pcoa().
After updating RStudio and R I now have version 2.0.3 of dartR and not 2.4 like I used to have.
Even when running:
library(dartR)
gl.install.vanilla.dartR(flavour = "dev")
# restart your R session: Menu > Session > Restart R
library(dartR)
I still am not able to re-install version 2.4

Could it be something I am missing?
Thanks,
Ana

messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Re: Dev version dartR - installation
parts:
Hi Ana,

The latest version of dartR is 2.0.3.

This is the current official version which is in CRAN and the master branch in github, previous versions were versions under development. 

You can install the latest version with:

> install.packages("dartR")

Cheers,
Luis
